choice_text: Go on the radio to back an annual tournament
result_text: You tell the radio audience that Sapporo should host the Grand Sumo tournament every year. The Traditional Society and the shopkeepers are delighted. The Care and Welfare Council and the Innovation Society are not.
promise_kept_text: You spend two hours at the radio station making the case for a yearly tournament, and the callers remember it.

choice_text: Welcome it this year and fund tickets for constituents
result_text: You tell the lobbyist Sapporo will welcome the tournament, and you pledge a block of tickets for constituents. The Traditional Society, Students United and Local Kōenkai are thrilled. The Taxpayers' Alliance, the Care and Welfare Council and the Innovation Society are not.
promise_kept_text: You spend four hours handing out tickets and seeing constituents into the arena. Students fill the cheap seats, and the shopkeepers stay open late.

choice_text: Reply that you are focused on more pressing issues
result_text: You write back that other matters come first this year. The Care and Welfare Council and the Innovation Society approve. The Traditional Society and the shopkeepers take note.

choice_text: Take your turn at the bell and stay for tea
result_text: The bell hums in your chest for a full minute. Over tea the abbot thanks you, and mentions the roof.

choice_text: Send a staff member with a donation for the repairs
result_text: Your staffer places the envelope in the offering box and signs the book on your behalf. The abbot sends a note of thanks.

choice_text: Offer to speak for the roof at the next heritage debate
result_text: You tell the abbot you will raise the bell tower roof when heritage funding is next debated. He writes it down, and so does a taxpayer in the back row.
promise_kept_text: You stand up in the heritage debate and name the bell tower roof. The abbot hears of it before you are back in your office.

choice_text: Run a portrait advertisement
result_text: Your face is on the regional page for a week.

choice_text: Run an advertisement about one issue
result_text: Readers write in about the issue, and some write in about you.

choice_text: Air a warm biography spot
result_text: Thirty seconds of someone who looks like they care.

choice_text: Air a clear policy spot
result_text: A clear voice and one number; people remember the number.

choice_text: Air a sharp attack spot
result_text: It is noticed. Not everyone approves of how.

choice_text: Fund the neighborhood festival
result_text: Paper lanterns and a banner with your name in small print.

choice_text: Fund a youth sports league
result_text: New shirts, a very loud first match.

choice_text: Fund a library renovation
result_text: A quiet opening and a plaque.

choice_text: A big speech from the stage
result_text: The hall is full for the opening and still full at the end.

choice_text: Walk the aisles and shake every hand
result_text: It takes three hours and every one of them matters.

choice_text: Give the journalist a short quote
result_text: Two sentences, accurately printed.

choice_text: Decline to comment, politely
result_text: The reporter thanks you and, a little coolly, goes away.

choice_text: Offer the journalist an exclusive
result_text: The story runs on the front page. It is slightly longer than you expected.

choice_text: Promise to look into the faster train
result_text: You start asking around. People have a lot to say about the train.
promise_kept_text: You spend an hour on the rail plans and send the shopkeeper a short note on who pays for what. He pins it up by the register.

choice_text: Say it is a matter for the city
result_text: He nods slowly and says nothing more.

choice_text: Ask him to start a petition
result_text: He looks pleased to have something to do.

choice_text: Attend and help set up
result_text: You carry chairs. People notice.

choice_text: Send a staffer in your place
result_text: Your staffer is charming. You are missed.

choice_text: Let it pass without comment
result_text: The rumor outlives the week.

choice_text: Address the rumor directly in public
result_text: A short, plain statement. Some believe it.

choice_text: Pay a consultant to calm it
result_text: Invoice attached.

choice_text: Reply in your own hand
result_text: A short note. A reply to your reply arrives a week later.

choice_text: Forward it to a staffer
result_text: It is answered, correctly, by someone else.

choice_text: Ask about the dues schedule
result_text: He is happy to explain it, at length.

choice_text: Offer a small advance
result_text: He writes you a receipt and remembers.

choice_text: Meet the hall secretary and members
result_text: They bring photographs and a long list. A coastal defense bill is being drafted.

choice_text: Send a short thank-you note
result_text: A polite reply comes back within the week.

choice_text: Pass it to a staffer
result_text: Your staffer replies, politely, on your behalf.

choice_text: Give them ten minutes and take notes
result_text: They want three things on one page. A bill on fiscal devolution is taking shape.

choice_text: Promise them a call in the next few days
result_text: You take their number. The call is on your list now.
promise_kept_text: The call runs long. The mayors read you their one page twice.

choice_text: Refer them to the party office
result_text: The party office is not thrilled.

choice_text: Hear them both out together
result_text: They disagree about the gate and agree about almost everything else. A heritage bill is being drafted.

choice_text: Visit the gate yourself
result_text: It is a very old gate.

choice_text: Say it is a local matter
result_text: They thank you stiffly.

choice_text: Listen until the next station
result_text: A digital-economy bill is starting to make sense.

choice_text: Take his card and call later
result_text: You pocket the card. You owe him a call.
promise_kept_text: You call the founder back. He talks for forty minutes and sends three follow-up emails before you hang up.

choice_text: Say you are busy today
result_text: He closes the laptop and glares at the window.

choice_text: Attend and stay to the end
result_text: Three retired officers take you aside. A security agreement is under discussion.

choice_text: Send your regrets with a note
result_text: Your note is read out with the other apologies.

choice_text: Leave early; promise a bottle of district sake
result_text: You are noticed leaving.
promise_kept_text: The bottle of district sake arrives at the embassy with your card. The retired officers drink to your health.

choice_text: Walk the empty floors with her
result_text: The visa rules are the problem, not the hotel. A tourism bill is on the table.

choice_text: Suggest she raise wages
result_text: She laughs politely.

choice_text: Write it up for the ministry
result_text: The ministry sends a form.

choice_text: Ask her about her whole work schedule
result_text: The wage is only half of it. A minimum-wage bill is being prepared.

choice_text: Say prices are up for everyone
result_text: She nods and puts the slip back in her bag.

choice_text: Take a photo of the slip, with her permission
result_text: She asks you not to post it. You do not.

choice_text: Stay and take every question
result_text: An education bill about moral instruction is being drafted, and these parents have views.

choice_text: Give a short speech and leave
result_text: They clap, politely.

choice_text: Decline to comment on schools
result_text: A parent says it is not a very good answer.

choice_text: Sit with him and ask what it has cost him
result_text: A local-voting bill is being drafted. Some will say you should not touch it.

choice_text: Say it is a national matter
result_text: He nods slowly.

choice_text: Write a letter of support for something else
result_text: He thanks you and does not mention it again.

choice_text: Drive out to the clinic yourself
result_text: A rural hospital bill is already half written; the nurse knows who to ask.

choice_text: Write to the prefecture about it
result_text: A reply arrives, in due course.

choice_text: Say the clinic should find its own funding
result_text: She says nothing and leaves.

choice_text: Visit the harbor and meet the fishing crews
result_text: A border-cooperation bill might actually fix this, and he has details.

choice_text: Forward the letter to the ministry
result_text: Nothing happens quickly.

choice_text: Keep the letter on file
result_text: It is a nice letter.

choice_text: Read a prepared message
result_text: Your voice is warm, and a little stiff.

choice_text: Answer listener calls live
result_text: Four callers, one of them cross.

choice_text: Buy the whole week of spots
result_text: Your voice is everywhere, which has costs.

choice_text: Pay for the shirts and the van
result_text: The team plays well and loses cheerfully.

choice_text: Pay and ask for a team photo
result_text: The photo does well locally.

choice_text: Pay, but keep your name out of it
result_text: The coach knows. So does the whole town.

choice_text: Be warm and personal
result_text: The host asks what you do on weekends.

choice_text: Stick to one policy
result_text: Listeners write in about the policy.

choice_text: Take on a tricky question
result_text: The clip circulates. Opinions differ.

choice_text: Meet everyone who comes
result_text: A morning of small problems, and one large one.

choice_text: Hold a short Q&A
result_text: Forty people stay for the answers.

choice_text: Invite local groups to tea
result_text: The tea does most of the work.

choice_text: Back the lead float
result_text: Your name goes on a banner. The float stays upright.

choice_text: Sponsor a drum group
result_text: The drummers are loud and well liked.

choice_text: Pay for cleanup volunteers
result_text: Nobody notices until the next morning.

choice_text: Take the call, live
result_text: You are on air before you have taken your coat off.

choice_text: Ask for a pre-arranged slot instead
result_text: The host agrees, a bit reluctantly.
promise_kept_text: You do the pre-arranged slot, with notes in hand. The host is warmer than he sounded on the phone.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: The host fills the time with music.

choice_text: Take every child's question
result_text: One asks if the Assembly has a roof. You say yes, and admit that it leaks.

choice_text: Give a short talk
result_text: The children are polite.

choice_text: Send a staff member
result_text: The teacher writes a gentle reply.

choice_text: Convene both neighborhoods in one room
result_text: It is loud for most of the hour and civil for the last ten minutes.

choice_text: Say the other neighborhood should host it
result_text: Whoever you named is furious.

choice_text: Commission an independent site study
result_text: A study. It takes a year.

choice_text: Post a short thank-you
result_text: It does well and stays civil.

choice_text: Leave the messages unanswered
result_text: The picture fades within a few days.

choice_text: Reply to every single message
result_text: It takes the rest of the afternoon. It works.

choice_text: Attend and speak about what he did
result_text: The room is small and the speech is short. People remember it.

choice_text: Send his family a box of Aomori apples
result_text: His family writes to thank you.

choice_text: Skip it and send a card
result_text: Someone notes your empty chair.

choice_text: Call the prefecture and stay on the line
result_text: A plow is sent. You are thanked in a very understated way.

choice_text: Send a message of support
result_text: They read it out at the village office.

choice_text: Say it is the prefecture's job
result_text: It is, but it does not read well.

choice_text: Go to the school at once
result_text: You stand at the gate with the principal. The bear is gone by the time anyone arrives.

choice_text: Call the prefecture's wildlife office
result_text: A team is dispatched, eventually.

choice_text: Say it is a wildlife matter
result_text: The principal thanks you for nothing.

choice_text: Invite them in and hear every petition
result_text: It takes an hour and a half. They leave less cold.

choice_text: Receive the folders at the door
result_text: The folders are received.

choice_text: Ask them to book an appointment
result_text: They write one. It is a very long queue.

choice_text: Pay part of it from your own pocket
result_text: The clerk writes you a receipt and rounds the balance down. It is a modest relief, and a visible one.

choice_text: Write back asking for more time
result_text: They reply politely. Politeness is not the same as patience.

choice_text: Ignore it and hope the week goes well
result_text: The envelope sits on the desk, looking back at you.

choice_text: Go through the receipts together
result_text: He finds two errors in your favor and one against. The books look cleaner afterward.

choice_text: Ask what the party spends the dues on
result_text: He answers at length. Some of it is fair, some of it is not, and he knows which.

choice_text: Say you are busy and send him away
result_text: He nods without surprise and writes something in the margin.

choice_text: Buy a seat at the head table
result_text: You shake a great many hands. The bill arrives with the dessert.

choice_text: Buy a cheaper seat by the door
result_text: The food is the same. So are the conversations that matter, just fewer of them.

choice_text: Send regrets and promise a box of cookies
result_text: A polite note goes back. Your place is given to someone else.
promise_kept_text: The box of cookies reaches the fundraiser's organizers with your apologies. They are gone before the speeches start.

choice_text: Sit with your party in the chamber
result_text: You sit shoulder to shoulder with your colleagues. When it is over, reporters ask what you made of it.

choice_text: Follow it from your office and take notes
result_text: You catch every line and miss the room. The notes will be useful later.

choice_text: Keep your appointments in the district instead
result_text: The chamber is full without you. Someone in the party notices.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to take it on. He says nothing more about the street, and a few people nearby notice.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline the invitation. The head table has one empty chair, and people notice whose.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You set the letter aside without answering. The resident notices when no reply comes.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to discuss it. The treasurer leaves a note and a cooler goodbye.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to engage. The hall secretary will remember that nobody answered.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to see them. The mayors leave without their ten minutes.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to get involved. The priest and the caretaker leave as they came.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to take it up. The owner thanks you and goes back to two shut floors.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to look at the slip. She puts it away without a word.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to discuss it. He says he understands, in the tone of someone who does not.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to act. The nurse says the doctor's Fridays will stay empty.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to take it further. The harbor office hears nothing back.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline the visit. The class waits for an answer that never comes.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to get involved. Both neighborhoods hear that you stayed out.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to take the call. The village office is left to call around.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to respond. The school manages without you.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to receive them. The folders stay in their plastic.

choice_text: Join the front row and follow the instructor
result_text: You are one beat behind the whole way through. Afterward an elder says the first set is always the hardest, and the group makes room for you.

choice_text: Send a staff member in your place
result_text: Your staffer is given a place in the front row and a flask of tea.

choice_text: Stop by, say thanks and leave
result_text: You stay for the bows at the end. They wave you off as you go.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline the invitation. The group counts one fewer in the front row, and someone notices.

choice_text: Stay all afternoon and listen to the elders
result_text: You hear the old songs and a long story told in two languages. The elders say you listened properly.

choice_text: Send a staff member to represent you
result_text: Your staffer is seated with the elders and takes careful notes.

choice_text: Give a short speech on Ainu heritage
result_text: You speak for three minutes about protecting Ainu heritage. The applause is warm, and not unanimous.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline the invitation. The seat set aside for you is quietly given away.

choice_text: Join the visit and take the students' questions
result_text: You walk the galleries with forty students and one very patient guide. Afterward three of them ask what the legislature is doing about it.

choice_text: Send a staff member with the students
result_text: Your staffer joins the tour and comes back with a bag of leaflets.

choice_text: Greet the students at the gate and leave
result_text: You shake a few hands at the door. The students say it was kind of you to come.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline the invitation. The students go without a legislator, and the center's staff notice.

choice_text: Go on air for the debate
result_text: The producer clips a microphone to your collar and counts you in.

choice_text: Send a staff member to speak for you
result_text: Your staffer holds the line politely. The other guest gets the last word.

choice_text: Offer a written statement instead
result_text: The host reads it out in a flat voice.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline the debate. The other guest has the whole morning to themselves.

choice_text: Take the stage and answer them
result_text: The hall is full and the first hand is already up.

choice_text: Send a staff member to take questions
result_text: Your staffer survives the hour and comes back with a long list.

choice_text: Send a recorded video message
result_text: It plays to a half-empty hall.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline the invitation. The students hold the event anyway, with an empty chair.

choice_text: Attend the meeting at the harbor
result_text: The hall smells of diesel and coffee. Every seat is taken.

choice_text: Send a staff member to listen
result_text: Your staffer takes four pages of notes and one hard look.

choice_text: Promise to raise it in committee
result_text: They have heard that before, and say so.
promise_kept_text: You raise the cooperative's concerns in committee and send the members the record of what was said.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to attend. The cooperative notes who stayed away.

choice_text: Give the speech and take questions
result_text: They want shorter permits and fewer surprises. They clap for both.

choice_text: Send a staff member with your notes
result_text: Your staffer reads the speech well. Nobody asks a question.

choice_text: Ask them to send their questions in writing
result_text: A thick envelope arrives the next morning.
promise_kept_text: You answer the Chamber's written questions, every one of them, in one long letter.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline the breakfast. The Chamber fills the slot with someone from another party.

choice_text: Sit for the full interview
result_text: The piece is fair, mostly. The photo is not your best.

choice_text: Have a staff member brief the reporter
result_text: The profile runs with a file photo and a careful quote.

choice_text: Offer a short written answer
result_text: They print two lines of it.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline the profile. The paper runs it anyway, from other people's quotes.

choice_text: Join the harvest crew in the fields
result_text: Your back aches for two days. They talk about it for longer.

choice_text: Send a staff member to help
result_text: Your staffer works hard and is invited back.

choice_text: Stop by for photos at the end
result_text: The photos are fine. The farmers notice the clean boots.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline the invitation. The cooperative brings the harvest in without you.

choice_text: Cut the ribbon and stay to talk
result_text: You leave with a small carved bear and a list of complaints about rent.

choice_text: Send a staff member to cut the ribbon
result_text: Your staffer cuts it neatly.

choice_text: Send a tin of milk caramels and a card
result_text: The tin sits open on the counter, your card propped against it.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline the opening. The ribbon is cut by the guild's oldest member.

choice_text: Ride the packed train with them
result_text: You are pressed against a door for forty minutes. They film all of it.

choice_text: Send a staff member to ride it
result_text: Your staffer survives and writes a very honest note.

choice_text: Say the timetable needs more study
result_text: The committee posts your answer on the station board.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline the ride. The committee posts a photo of the empty space where you would have stood.

choice_text: Answer every question on the scorecard
result_text: You score better than you expected and worse than you hoped.

choice_text: Have a staff member fill it out
result_text: Your staffer's answers are careful and dull. So is your grade.

choice_text: Say the scorecard is biased
result_text: They print that, in bold, next to your blank grade.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline the scorecard. The Alliance gives you an incomplete.

choice_text: Chair the roundtable yourself
result_text: The bankers talk about risk. The shop owners talk about rent. You keep them in the room.

choice_text: Send a staff member to take notes
result_text: Your staffer comes back with twelve pages and one good idea.

choice_text: Ask for a written brief instead
result_text: The brief is forty pages long.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline the roundtable. The association holds it with a ministry official.

choice_text: Take the file and promise a reply
result_text: You read the first fifty. They are all about the same three companies.
promise_kept_text: You write back to the network with a reply from the ministry and a list of what happens next.

choice_text: Have a staff member log every complaint
result_text: Your staffer builds a spreadsheet the network can use.

choice_text: Forward it to the ministry unread
result_text: The ministry thanks you for your interest.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline the file. The network carries it to the next office down the corridor.

choice_text: Propose a third site with a community fund
result_text: A third site, and a fund for whoever takes it. The room goes quiet, then agrees.

choice_text: Back the site with the shortest truck route
result_text: The numbers favor one street. That street is not happy.

choice_text: Ask both to agree on an independent study
result_text: They agree on the study, if nothing else.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You stay away from the meeting you called. Both neighborhoods notice.

choice_text: Send the reply on with a note of your own
result_text: The customs officer writes back to thank you, in the same careful hand.

choice_text: Ask the ministry for a review date in writing
result_text: A date arrives. It is next year, but it is a date.

choice_text: File the reply and leave it there
result_text: The harbor office hears nothing more.

choice_text: Share the survey so fans can fill it out
result_text: A celebrity's fans fill out the survey within a day.

choice_text: Raise the route at the Committee on Construction and Development
result_text: The committee notes it. The minutes say so.

choice_text: Let the matter rest for now
result_text: The survey stays in its envelope.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You set the ministry's reply aside. The customs officer never hears of it.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You leave the airline's letter unanswered.

choice_text: Commit to bring them a Haskap Yoitomake and its story
result_text: You promise them a Yezo sweet before they leave.
promise_kept_text: You tell them about the haskap berries that local families have gathered for generations, and the confectioners who roll them into the iconic sponge cakes. They take pictures of it for their social media and leave with the story.

choice_text: Share a box of Yezo cookies
result_text: The host is delighted. The cookies are expected before the delegation leaves.
promise_kept_text: The cookies arrive at the farewell reception. The delegation passes the box around and asks where to buy more.

choice_text: Send a staff member with a welcome letter
result_text: Your staffer reads the letter aloud. The delegation is polite, and a little disappointed.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to receive them. The delegation finishes its tour without meeting a single legislator.

choice_text: Hand out every certificate yourself
result_text: You kneel to hand each certificate over. One man reads his twice.

choice_text: Send a staff member with a message from you
result_text: Your staffer reads your message. It is warmly received, and quickly over.

choice_text: Give a short speech on care for the elderly
result_text: You speak for five minutes about home care. The front row nods; the back row naps.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline the invitation. The certificates are handed out by the association chair.

choice_text: Join the morning cleanup with residents
result_text: You fill four bags before breakfast. The residents take a photograph.

choice_text: Send a staff member to help with the cleanup
result_text: Your staffer fills two bags and brings back a sunburn.

choice_text: Ask the ward for more bins next spring
result_text: The ward promises to look at it before next spring.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline. The residents clear the park without you.

choice_text: Ask the police to tow it today
result_text: The tow truck comes by evening. A child waves it goodbye.

choice_text: Have a staff member check on the owner first
result_text: Your staffer finds the owner has been in the hospital since spring. His family moves the car.

choice_text: Leave a note on the windshield
result_text: The note is still there a week later, a little faded.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to get involved. The car stays where it is.

choice_text: Walk the washout with the farmers
result_text: You stand in the mud where the road used to be. The farmers notice your shoes.

choice_text: Send a staff member with a camera
result_text: Your staffer's photographs reach the prefecture by evening.

choice_text: Press the prefecture for an emergency repair
result_text: You promise the co-op you will press the prefecture within two days.
promise_kept_text: You press the prefecture until a crew is sent, and a gravel road is open within the week.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline the visit. The farmers walk the washout on their own.

choice_text: Ask your supporters to take them down this weekend
result_text: Your supporters clear all three corners and keep one poster as a souvenir.

choice_text: Have a staff member call the ward to remove them
result_text: The ward removes them, and sends your office a polite reminder.

choice_text: Leave them; the ward will get to it
result_text: Someone draws a mustache on your face.

choice_text: Attend and give a short toast
result_text: You keep the toast to two minutes. The grandmother says it was three too short.

choice_text: Send a telegram of congratulations
result_text: The telegram is read out between the speeches.

choice_text: Send a staff member with a gift
result_text: Your staffer brings a gift and leaves with cake.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline the invitation. Your seat at the reception is given to a cousin.

choice_text: Organize a cleanup day with residents
result_text: Twenty residents clear the ditch in an afternoon. The next rain stays in it.

choice_text: Send a staff member to photograph it for the ward
result_text: Your staffer's photographs reach the ward office the same day.

choice_text: Press the ward for a permanent drain
result_text: You promise the residents you will press the ward for a real drain.
promise_kept_text: You press the ward, and a covered drain goes on next year's public works list.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline. The ditch floods again with the next rain.

choice_text: Agree, and run the first lap
result_text: You finish the first lap in last place, to loud applause.

choice_text: Agree, and send a staff member to the start line
result_text: Your staffer sounds the starting horn.

choice_text: Ask to see their accounts first
result_text: The accounts are in order. The organizers are a little hurt you asked.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline. The run goes ahead with another patron's name.

choice_text: Walk the corner with her this evening
result_text: The light hums. She points out the next three dark corners.

choice_text: Write to thank the ward office
result_text: The ward office is surprised to be thanked.

choice_text: Ask the ward about the next corner too
result_text: You promise to raise the next corner with the ward.
promise_kept_text: You raise the next corner with the ward, and it goes on the same repair list.

choice_text: Give the paper the story
result_text: The story runs with your photograph. Some readers ask why their own forms are still waiting.

choice_text: Keep it private, as the family asked
result_text: The family sends a short card from abroad.

choice_text: Credit the ministry staff who rushed it
result_text: The ministry clerks pin the article to their bulletin board.

choice_text: Get nets for the next street too
result_text: You promise the next street its nets.
promise_kept_text: You get nets for the next street. The crows move on to the river.

choice_text: Tell them to buy nets as a group
result_text: They buy nets as a group, and grumble as a group.

choice_text: Ask the ward to change pickup times citywide
result_text: The ward agrees to study pickup times.

choice_text: Share the doughnuts with your staff
result_text: Your staff decide you should fix more potholes.

choice_text: Thank the road crew in person
result_text: The road crew is not used to being thanked. The foreman offers you a hard hat.

choice_text: Attend and say a few words
result_text: The old man shakes your hand for a long time.

choice_text: Send a staff member with a letter
result_text: Your letter is read out and pinned beside his old photograph.

choice_text: Ask the ministry how many claims are stuck like his
result_text: You promise the association you will ask how many others are waiting.
promise_kept_text: You ask the ministry. Forty claims are stuck the same way, and a clerk is assigned to them.

choice_text: Help him apply for a demolition grant
result_text: The grant covers most of it. The animals living there will need a new home.

choice_text: Tell him the cost is his
result_text: He says he will think about it, from Sapporo.

choice_text: Ask the village whether it wants the land
result_text: The village hall fills with ideas for the land, most of them for a park.

choice_text: Ask the town to offer the land
result_text: The town agrees, after a long meeting.

choice_text: Ask the carrier to pay rent like anyone else
result_text: The carrier says it will consider it, which means no.

choice_text: Ask the other carriers to share the tower
result_text: Two carriers agree to share, if the third goes first.

choice_text: Hold a second session in Kushiro
result_text: You promise a second session for the next town.
promise_kept_text: You hold the second session. A man stands up to say he hung up on one this morning.

choice_text: Push the banks to hold large transfers by the elderly
result_text: The banks agree to a call-back on large transfers, grudgingly.

choice_text: Send a staff member door to door with leaflets
result_text: Your staffer delivers two hundred leaflets and hears a hundred stories.

choice_text: Ask the company to move it one ridge further from the cape
result_text: The company agrees to study the far ridge. The farmers applaud.

choice_text: Back the turbine where the company planned it
result_text: The company thanks you. The back row does not.

choice_text: Ask for a share of the power income for the village
result_text: The company offers a small share. The village asks for a bigger one.

choice_text: Call for a full public accounting
result_text: You ask for every cost to be explained in open session. The Alliance takes notes. The program's supporters do not enjoy the afternoon.

choice_text: Send a staff member to read the audit with them
result_text: Your staffer sits through the whole report and brings back three questions worth asking.

choice_text: Ask the program for a written reply first
result_text: The program answers in a long letter. The Alliance calls it a good start for someone else's money.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline the Alliance's request. They read the report aloud without you.

choice_text: Speak for the freeze at the hearing
result_text: You say the fee has grown faster than wages. The crowd applauds. The council members from the countryside frown.

choice_text: Send a staff member to hold your place on the list
result_text: Your staffer speaks in the third minute of public comment and keeps it short.

choice_text: Propose a review of the fee instead
result_text: You offer to ask for a review next season. The countryside members nod. The Alliance does not.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to speak. The hearing goes on without a legislator in the room.

choice_text: Cut the ribbon and walk the stalls
result_text: Fifty stalls, three hundred handshakes, one very sore foot. The Chamber is pleased. Some residents say the street was closed all day.

choice_text: Send a staff member with your welcome speech
result_text: Your staffer reads the speech and visits every stall. The Chamber says thank you politely.

choice_text: Send a letter of welcome instead
result_text: The letter is read from the stage. The Chamber thanks you. The residents on the closed street thank you more.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline the invitation. The Chamber's own president cuts the ribbon.

choice_text: Ask the ministry to speed the permits
result_text: You make the call. The ministry promises a quicker review. The Chamber and the harbor are pleased. The unions ask who checks the checking.

choice_text: Send a staff member to the port with a list of questions
result_text: Your staffer visits the dock office and returns with the permit timeline.

choice_text: Insist that the usual checks stay in place
result_text: You say the order is welcome and the checks stay. The unions approve. The buyer waits another week.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to get involved. The buyer takes the order to another port.

choice_text: Back the shopkeepers' request
result_text: You tell the council the street needs the evening trade. The shopkeepers cheer. A resident calls it a promise of noise.

choice_text: Send a staff member to hear both sides
result_text: Your staffer spends an evening on the street and writes down every complaint and every receipt.

choice_text: Back a one-month trial with a noise limit
result_text: The trial is agreed. The residents are relieved. The shopkeepers say a month is a short time to win a customer.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to take a side. The council decides without you.

choice_text: Ask the ministry for a simpler form
result_text: You write to the ministry on the shop's behalf. The owner pins the reply behind the register. Consumer groups ask what is being simplified away.

choice_text: Send a staff member to see the form and the shop
result_text: Your staffer fills out the form twice and counts the hours. It is eleven.

choice_text: Back the rule and ask for help paying for it
result_text: You say the rule is sound and the cost is the problem. Consumer groups agree. The owner thinks you are splitting hairs.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to write the letter. The shop closes an hour earlier each Friday.

choice_text: Endorse the scheme at its launch
result_text: You stand beside the bankers and say the district needs more first-time owners. The Innovation Society is delighted. Students worry about the interest.

choice_text: Send a staff member to read the fine print
result_text: Your staffer returns with a page of questions about repayment and one about collateral.

choice_text: Ask for gentler terms before you endorse
result_text: The bankers agree to look again. Students United says that is the first sensible thing anyone has said about it.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to endorse the scheme. The bankers launch it quietly.

choice_text: Attend the workshop and speak
result_text: You tell a full hall how to spot a fake bank message. Several people write the phone number down. The picnic goes ahead without you.

choice_text: Send a staff member to the workshop with your notes
result_text: Your staffer takes questions for an hour and comes back with a list of the commonest scams.

choice_text: Go to the picnic instead
result_text: You eat rice balls on a blanket with forty families. The bankers say they hope to see you next time.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline both. The weekend is quiet, and the hall is not.

choice_text: Praise the boldest proposal publicly
result_text: You pick the idea nobody expected. The founders cheer. An older neighbor mutters that boldness is easy when it is someone else's savings.

choice_text: Send a staff member to take notes on every pitch
result_text: Your staffer returns with eleven pitches ranked, and a question about each.

choice_text: Praise the one that fits a local trade
result_text: You pick the plan to modernize a family workshop. Traditionalists nod. The Society says it hoped for something braver.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to choose a favorite. The founders go home without one.

choice_text: Back the conversion
result_text: You say the mill has been empty for years and the town needs the work. The Society and the Chamber thank you. The council from the countryside is not so sure.

choice_text: Send a staff member to visit the mill and the neighbors
result_text: Your staffer walks the site and reports that the roof is sound and the neighbors are divided.

choice_text: Ask the firm to keep the front of the old mill
result_text: The firm says it will think about the front wall. The residents are glad. The Society calls it an expensive wall.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to take a position. The firm applies without you.

choice_text: Become a patron and back the waiver
result_text: Your name goes on the board outside the hall, and the stalls stay free. The Financial Industry Association asks who covers the lost fees.

choice_text: Send a staff member with a note of thanks
result_text: Your staffer buys a lacquer tray and returns with the fair's printed history.

choice_text: Support the fair but not the waiver
result_text: You pay for a stall yourself and leave the fees as they are. The Financial Industry Association approves. The fair's elders are polite about it.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to be named. The fair goes ahead on a smaller scale.

choice_text: Back a public grant for the roof
result_text: You tell the council the hall is where the district keeps its calendar. The Society and the neighbors are pleased. The Financial Industry Association asks who covers the bill.

choice_text: Send a staff member to inspect the roof and the quotes
result_text: Your staffer climbs a ladder, takes photographs and returns with three quotes and a stain on one sleeve.

choice_text: Back a local appeal instead of a grant
result_text: You help start a collection and give first. The Financial Industry Association approves. The Society says a roof is a lot of bake sales.

choice_text: Decline
result_text: You decline to back either plan. The hall's buckets multiply.
